correctness.rationale: Integrating dN/dt=-N/(c+hN) gives T=c log(N0/N)+h(N0-N) and a unique survivor. Equality of survivors yields Nc log(N0/N)=N0-N and T=q log(N0/N), hence necessary-and-sufficient threshold. Continuous dependence and the unique threshold plus low-stock and high-stock scalar comparison determine strict signs. The function s/(1-e^-s) is strictly increasing from 1 to infinity and selects one positive switch; W0 yields u in (0,1), while W_{-1} corresponds to T=0. Independent numerical inversion gives threshold 2.5059407020437066 and correct signs on either side.
